warning_excerpt:
!! Memory pressure warning: this model is likely too large for your hardware.
  Continuing may trigger a macOS kernel panic (see issue #324).

    Model on disk:             11.4 GB
    Est. working set:          17.2 GB  (model x 1.5 — short-chat workload; long-context serving will use more)
    Currently used by OS:       8.7 GB
    Total system RAM:          16.0 GB  (162% projected utilization)

  Apple Silicon firmware can panic the whole system rather than
  raise an OOM error when unified-memory pressure exceeds the
  iBoot AMCC threshold. Recommended actions:

    - Close other apps to free RAM, or
    - Pick a smaller model:    rapid-mlx models
    - Or lower memory headroom: rapid-mlx serve <model> --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75
